business_model.claim: Cushman & Wakefield is a global commercial real estate services firm that sells advisory and execution services to real estate occupiers and investors, through four service lines: Services, Leasing, Capital markets, and Valuation and other.
quotes: Cushman & Wakefield Ltd. (together with its subsidiaries, “Cushman & Wakefield,” “the Company,” “we,” “ours” and “us”) is a leading global commercial real estate services firm driven to solve complex problems for real estate occupiers and investors.

business_model.claim: The company reports through three geographic segments: the Americas, EMEA and APAC, which made up 73%, 10% and 17% of 2025 total revenue. The United States alone was 69% of 2025 revenue.
quotes: Our business is organized, and we report our operating results, through three geographic segments: the Americas; Europe, Middle East and Africa (“EMEA”); and Asia Pacific (“APAC”) representing 73%, 10% and 17% of our 2025 total revenue and 71%, 13% and 16% of our 2025 service line fee revenue, respectively.

business_model.claim: Services is the largest line, at 66% of 2025 revenue. It covers property, facilities and project management, is generally recurring and contractual, and is often under multi-year contracts with relatively high switching costs. Fees are fixed recurring or variable (hours, cost mark-up, or share of gross receipts), and much of the revenue is third-party costs passed through to clients.
quotes: Revenues in this service line are generally recurring in nature, many through multi-year contracts with relatively high switching costs.

business_model.claim: Leasing fees are earned after a lease is signed and are calculated as a percentage of the total rent payable over the lease. Capital markets fees are earned at the close of a transaction as a percentage of the transaction value, so they depend on transaction volume and velocity.
quotes: Our Capital markets fees are transactional in nature and generally earned at the close of a transaction as a percentage of the total value of the transaction.

business_model.claim: Valuation and other brings in appraisal, valuation advisory, investment management and related fees, which are earned on both a contractual and transactional basis and are generally fixed by engagement scope. It was 5% of 2025 revenue.
quotes: Fees are earned on both a contractual and transactional basis and are generally fixed based on the scope of the engagement.
